name: Rahul Verma
headline: Lead Java Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with 9 years building high-volume Java services for payments, insurance and telecoms. I design for failure first: idempotency, back-pressure and clear ownership between services.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Lead a team of eight building the UPI settlement platform: 14 Spring Boot microservices processing 3 million transactions a day.
Designed the Kafka event backbone with exactly-once settlement, removing nightly reconciliation breaks.
Moved the services onto Kubernetes with autoscaling, cutting peak-hour latency from 900 ms to 180 ms.
Partitioned the PostgreSQL ledger by month and brought month-end reporting from hours to minutes.
Upgraded the codebase from Java 11 to Java 21 and adopted virtual threads for the I/O-heavy services.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Broke the policy-administration monolith into Spring Cloud microservices with service discovery and circuit breakers.
Built the premium-calculation service in Spring Boot, serving 200 partner brokers.
Tuned MySQL indexes and connection pools, halving p95 response times on quote APIs.
Containerised all services with Docker for the move to a shared platform.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built Java modules for a prepaid-recharge platform used by 12 million subscribers.
Mapped the subscriber and tariff model with Hibernate and removed N+1 queries from the hot paths.
Wrote JUnit suites and Maven build profiles that let the team release weekly instead of monthly.

certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer
